title: Test useLimits hook
description: Unit-test the useLimits hook (src/hooks/use-limits.ts) which enforces freemium caps on maps and publishers. Mock the InstantDB query hook and the two React contexts it consumes. This is the highest-risk piece of product logic: a regression here could silently disable the paywall or falsely block paying users.
steps: Add 'jest-environment-jsdom' or configure a per-file @jest-environment docblock for this test (hooks need a DOM environment)
Install @testing-library/react-hooks if not present: bun add -d @testing-library/react-hooks react-test-renderer
Mock '@/contexts/session-provider' to expose a controllable useSession stub
Mock '@/hooks/use-subscription' to expose a controllable useSubscription stub
Mock '@/lib/db' so db.useQuery returns controllable mapsData / publishersData
Mock '@/constants/env' to set FREE_LIMITS = { maps: '3', publishers: '2' }
Write tests: subscribed user → all limits false regardless of counts
Write tests: free user with 0 maps and 0 publishers → no limits reached
Write tests: free user at exact limit (mapsCount === FREE_LIMITS.maps) → mapsReached true
Write tests: free user with one publisher over limit → publishersReached true, anyLimitReached true
Write tests: no congregation → counts default to 0, no limits reached
tests: Subscribed user: mapsReached = false even when mapsCount > FREE_LIMITS.maps
Subscribed user: publishersReached = false even when publishersCount > FREE_LIMITS.publishers
Free user, 0 maps, 0 publishers: all reached flags false
Free user, mapsCount === FREE_LIMITS.maps: mapsReached = true
Free user, mapsCount < FREE_LIMITS.maps: mapsReached = false
Free user, publishersCount > FREE_LIMITS.publishers: publishersReached = true, anyLimitReached = true
No congregation: mapsCount = 0, publishersCount = 0, no limits reached
Counts are correctly returned in both subscribed and free cases
acceptanceCriteria: All 9 tests pass with bun test
Mocks are fully reset between tests (no cross-test pollution)
